clauses.title: Every tooling failure stays terminal
requires: Tool/startup/API/timeout/stale-target/malformed-output/correlation failures are not verdicts, consume no counter, are not retried, and stop, except for the CL-D39 recovery defined above, the CL-D51 zero-output relaunch, and the CL-D86 recomposition after a push.

clauses.title: Exact autofix owns one bounded pre-writer recovery
requires: One recovery is permitted for either a deterministic local tooling failure under the original CL-D39 rows or the CL-D51 pure gate transport failure with zero designated output bytes
no Luna task, commit, push, or reply exists
the budget is exactly one per key
invalidates only the failed operation's own output
Recovery never launches a second writer, repeats a provider mutation, or re-enters a phase after Luna starts

clauses.title: The authority baseline is raised for the closed mapping
clauses.section: ## CL-D39 — Exact autofix gains one bounded pre-writer recovery
requires: raises the six-file authority baseline from 112,000 to 116,000 bytes
the shortfall is funded by the raise rather than by a trim
